paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Yaakov of Tzor (Tyre). See entry: R' Yishmael ben Yaakov of Tzor (Tyre).[^1]

notes.text: ערך is the cross-reference marker; דמן צור means of Tzor (Tyre). Shimon and Yishmael remain different supplied names, not an admitted identity. Both source titles are abbreviated and remain R'; catalog רבי does not expand the supplied ר׳. Earlier machine עיך differs from supplied ערך.
